Why families stay

You should not need four offices for one mouth.

Most practices send you elsewhere for wisdom teeth, braces or a root canal. We do all of it here, with the same team and the same chart. That is the whole idea, and it has been since the doors opened in 2003.

Cosmetic Dentistry

Veneers, bonding and Zoom whitening. More ways to a younger looking smile than most people expect.

Children and teens

Bring everyone at once.

We can arrange family block appointments so you and your children are all seen at the same time, without anyone sitting in the waiting room reading a magazine for an hour.

We see children from age three, because baby teeth matter more than people think. They guide the permanent teeth in, and they shape how a child learns to speak.

  • Family block appointments, everyone seen together
  • We see children from age three
  • Gentle first visits for anxious kids
  • Mouthguards for school and club sports
Book the whole family
Advanced technology

A crown in one visit, not three.

CEREC lets us design, mill and fit a permanent crown while you wait. No temporary crown, no second appointment, no two weeks of chewing carefully on one side.

  • CEREC single visit crowns
  • Digital imaging, far less radiation than film
  • Zoom whitening in about an hour
  • Digital impressions instead of the tray of putty

Robinwood's site says nothing about cost at all. The three cards below use only what they already promise. A membership plan and a new patient offer are worth adding, with numbers the practice sets.

Questions we hear a lot

Straight answers.

What this fixesEvery answer here comes from a page on their current site, gathered into one place and written the way people ask. On the real build this section also carries FAQ markup so Google can show these answers directly in search results.
Do you take my insurance?

We accept most dental insurance plans and file the claim for you. Aetna, MetLife, United Concordia, Guardian, CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield, Cigna and Delta Dental are a few of the carriers we are providers for. Before treatment we tell you up front what we estimate your plan will pay.

Can I get in today?

Often, yes. Same-day appointments are frequently available, so call 240.313.9660 and ask. If it is a medical emergency, call 911.

What should I do before my first visit?

Preregister so your paperwork is done before you walk in. On the real site that happens on your phone; today it is a form you print and bring. Bring your insurance card and a list of any medications.

What if I need to cancel?

Let us know as soon as you can and we will find you a better time. We appreciate two business days notice.

How young can my child start?

We see children from age three. Baby teeth matter: they hold space for adult teeth and shape how a child learns to speak. Ask about family block appointments so everyone is seen at once.

Can you do a crown in one visit?

Yes. With CEREC we design, mill and fit a permanent crown while you wait, so there is no temporary crown and no second appointment.

Am I a candidate for Invisalign?

Probably. We are an Elite Invisalign provider and a free consultation answers the question for sure, including cases other offices have turned down.

I am nervous about the dentist. Is that a problem?

Not at all. It comes up every day. For oral surgery we offer a range of anxiety management options, and for everything else we go at your pace and explain each step.

How do I pay?

We welcome major credit cards, and you can pay your balance online any time through the link in the footer.
